text.p: These are the leading stories in Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

"The Macedonian strategic goal is to become member of the European integrations and NATO. We should continue with our economic and democratic reforms," Macedonian Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski says inaugurating the first class of Macedonian army officers.

- "In one year this is going to be Albania. The Government has sold us out. Last Thursday (Albanians) have burned the Macedonian flag," Macedonians from west Macedonia tell the newspaper. Albanians in turn claim the Macedonians are treating them as second class citizens.
